name: Hotel Brennerspitz
beschreibung: The Hotel Brennerspitz welcomes visitors to a sunny, peaceful setting in the Scheibe district at Franz-Senn-Straße 160 in Neustift im Stubaital. Styled with classic Tyrolean country warmth, this distinguished four-star hotel features comfortable rooms and suites equipped with contemporary en-suite bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing views of the prominent Brennerspitze peak and the glaciated Stubai Alps. A spacious on-site wellness oasis complete with an indoor swimming pool, Finnish sauna, steam room, whirlpool, and quiet relaxation lounges delivers deeply soothing regeneration. In the dining room, guests are treated to nutritious breakfast spreads and multi-course evening dinners spotlighting regional produce. The complimentary ski bus stops right at the property, offering seamless transit to the snow-sure Stubai Glacier as well as the Elfer and Schlick 2000 ski domains. In summer, boundless alpine walking trails await.
kurzbeschreibung: Four-star alpine hotel on Franz-Senn-Straße in Neustift im Stubaital with an indoor pool, saunas, and near the Stubai Glacier.
